doc.name: A — small appliance catalogue, stone plinth, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: espresso machine portafilter
Category: small appliance
Shot programme: stone plinth
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You run the tabletop stage for a premium small appliance product shoot. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the top-down flat in a stone plinth treatment.

SUBJECT. A espresso machine portafilter. Treat the attached reference as the single source of truth for the product's geometry, proportion, colourway, finish and label typography. Do not redesign, restyle, re-letter or embellish it.

CAMERA. Directly overhead, product and props arranged on a single plane. Shoot on a 24mm wide at f/11, framing for dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with a single 90cm softbox key at 45 degrees with a white bounce card for fill. Stage the product on or against corrugated metal, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a pastel low-contrast grade with a lifted black point. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
